main.description: A link to a file that carries its own authority, for what cannot send an `Authorization` header: an `<iframe>`, a `<video>`, a document viewer on another server. Whoever holds the link reads that one file until it expires, so it is made only for a caller who may read the file. Pictures do not need one: fetch `/blob/<id>` with the session instead.

expires.description: Unix seconds. Ask again before then for a file still on screen.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such file, or none the caller may read.
